# telnyx_porting_phone_numbers (Data Source)

The phone numbers in porting orders.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_porting_order_status` (String) Filter results by porting order status One of `cancel-pending`, `cancelled`, `draft`, `exception`, `foc-date-confirmed`, `in-process`, `ported`, `submitted`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `porting_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_phone_numbers))

<a id="nestedatt--porting_phone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_phone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `activation_status` (String) Activation status
- `phone_number` (String) E164 formatted phone number
- `phone_number_type` (String) The type of the phone number
- `portability_status` (String) Specifies whether Telnyx is able to confirm portability this number in the United States & Canada. International phone numbers are provisional by default.
- `porting_order_id` (String) Identifies the associated port request
- `porting_order_status` (String) The current status of the porting order
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `requirements_status` (String) The current status of the requirements in a INTL porting order
- `support_key` (String) A key to reference this porting order when contacting Telnyx customer support
